title: Evertrue Capital Launches $17M Fund for European Startups
excerpt: Yvonne Bajela's Evertrue Capital has announced a $17 million debut fund focused on early-stage AI and fintech companies in Europe.
body_html:
Evertrue Capital has officially launched with a $17 million debut fund aimed at supporting early-stage startups across Europe. Led by Yvonne Bajela, the new investment vehicle will focus primarily on companies operating in the artificial intelligence and financial technology sectors.

The fresh capital injection seeks to bolster the European startup ecosystem by providing early financial backing to emerging enterprises in these high-demand industries.
